parts.article:
Section three.

You will hear a conversation between a student and her professor discussing an assignment. First, you have some time to look at questions twenty-one to twenty-five.

Now, listen carefully and answer questions twenty-one to twenty-five.

Excuse me, Dr. Thompson, may I speak to you for a minute?

Of course. Please come in.

I’m Alexandra Jones. I’m studying business here at the university, and for my assignment, I have to carry out a survey of people who own their own organizations. I heard that you are the founder of your own company, and I was wondering if I could ask you some questions about it.

Yes, of course. Please fire away.

Okay, great. We’ll get started. Did you encounter any problems whilst you were starting your company?

Actually, it was not as hard as I anticipated. I started out with very clear objectives, so I knew exactly what I wanted my corporate identity to be.

It was very difficult to find the correct premises, as the property market in London is so competitive, but eventually I found the perfect site.

The hardest part was structuring the business, as I had no formal template, so I had to create it myself.

Yes, that is very impressive. Was it difficult dealing with staff?

It’s always tricky trying to satisfy a group of people with varying interests. However, I didn’t encounter many problems. I found it very important to make the staff feel appreciated, so I hosted a staff day where we could all introduce ourselves and get to know each other as individuals.

I was also able to talk to them about the type of work that they would be doing and gave them the opportunity to share with me the issues they had with the allocation of the work.

Okay. Did you hire a management team, or did you take on the role of the manager?

Oh, no. I already had enough tasks to take care of.

I employed someone else to take on the role of the manager. However, he never consulted me before making decisions, so I was forced to let him go and hire someone else.

And what did the other staff think of the new manager?

They had a great deal of respect for him. It definitely helped that I consulted with them before hiring him. They were surprised that he has been so successful in his role at the company, despite the longer meeting hours.

Since the company opened, has it had any great achievements?

There are many aspects of the company that I am pleased with. However, there is one achievement of which I am particularly proud. I wanted a mural painted to brighten up our entrance area, so I decided it would be a great idea to invite the local primary school to create one for us. The youngsters had a great time, and I know they were thrilled to be included.

Oh, that’s lovely.

Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions twenty-six to thirty.

Now listen and answer questions twenty-six to thirty.

Have you encountered any major problems since you opened the company?

Yes, we are always encountering issues with employment because it is very hard to find people who are qualified for the roles that we are offering. But unfortunately, there is no solution to this.

One of our administrators also recently left to go on maternity leave, which put us in a tricky situation. However, we have managed to find a temporary replacement for her.

It’s also now approaching the period when we must carry out our financial training, so I need to find a venue with enough space to hold everyone.

It will be interesting trying to organize that event.

Oh, gosh, I can imagine. I find it hard enough to organize myself.

Organization is a difficult thing to master, but it is also essential for success. Whilst I was learning how to stay organized, I realized that the role of motivation is essential.

Okay, that’s great.

I also suggest that you visit the library, as there is a section on culture that will have some very valuable material on how to develop your organization skills.

Okay. I’ll head to the library when we’re finished.

I think you will find it very useful. They also have a collection of documentaries on the subject of personal organization, and I suggest that you look up the literature on management of change. I personally found these sources incredibly useful. Articles are also a valuable resource, and we have a whole collection of them in our university library. I advise that you look at section two, where you will find articles on the nature of volunteering.

That’s great. Thank you so much for your help.

No problem.

That is the end of section three. You now have half a minute to check your answers.

questions.question: What was the most difficult problem when the company was founded?

analyses.content: 录音明确指出创办公司时最难的部分（hardest part）是没有现成的正式模板，需要自己构建业务架构，直接对应选项B（没有正式的架构）。
你可能会因为听到“very clear objectives”或者“difficult to find the correct premises”而错选A或C，但前者是她一开始就具备的优势，后者虽然困难但最终圆满解决，只有构建架构被明确强调为“最困难的（hardest part）”。

Did you encounter any problems whilst you were starting your company? Actually, it was not as hard as I anticipated. I started out with very clear objectives, so I knew exactly what I wanted my corporate identity to be. It was very difficult to find the correct premises, as the property market in London is so competitive, but eventually I found the perfect site. The hardest part was structuring the business, as I had no formal template, so I had to create it myself.

questions.question: What is the staff unsatisfied with?

analyses.content: 录音中明确提到员工向老板分享了他们在工作分配（allocation of the work）上遇到的问题（issues），“allocation”直接替换了选项B中的“assignment”。
你可能一听到“make the staff feel appreciated”或“type of work”就匆忙选择了C或A，但前者是老板为了激励员工采取的正面举措，后者只是双方沟通的一个话题，员工真正感到不满并提出问题的是工作的分配方式。

Was it difficult dealing with staff? It’s always tricky trying to satisfy a group of people with varying interests. However, I didn’t encounter many problems. I found it very important to make the staff feel appreciated, so I hosted a staff day where we could all introduce ourselves and get to know each other as individuals. I was also able to talk to them about the type of work that they would be doing and gave them the opportunity to share with me the issues they had with the allocation of the work.

analyses.content: 录音中提到这位被雇佣的经理在做决定前从不请示老板（never consulted me before making decisions），完全对应选项C“总是自己做决定”。

analyses.content: 录音先阐述了雇佣人员方面一直存在困难，紧接着用转折词“But”引出关键结论：“不幸的是，目前没有解决方案（there is no solution to this）”。
你可能把全部注意力放在了前面描述“招人困难”的具体细节上，从而忽略了表示总结和转折的句子，做填空题一定要警惕转折连词（But/However）后出现的实质性名词。

Have you encountered any major problems since you opened the company? Yes, we are always encountering issues with employment because it is very hard to find people who are qualified for the roles that we are offering. But unfortunately, there is no solution to this.
录音在提及如何保持条理（stay organized）时，明确总结道“动机的作用是至关重要的（the role of motivation is essential）”，“essential”直接对应了题干的“is of great importance”。
你可能会因为没跟上“stay organized”这个核心定位词，或者听到前一句话的“success”就匆忙填入，做题时必须耐心听完定位词所在的完整从句，并抓住直接修饰“essential”的主语。
Organization is a difficult thing to master, but it is also essential for success. Whilst I was learning how to stay organized, I realized that the role of motivation is essential.
录音中教授建议去图书馆，并极其直白地提到那里有一个“关于文化的区域（a section on culture）”，完全符合题干结构。
这道题信息给得非常直接，你可能会因为短暂走神漏听了“section on”这个极短的介词搭配而错过答案，要注意当录音提到具体方位（library）时，答案随时会出现。

Okay, that’s great. I also suggest that you visit the library, as there is a section on culture that will have some very valuable material on how to develop your organization skills. Okay, I’ll head to the library when we’re finished.
教授在推荐资料时，建议学生查阅“关于变革管理的文献（the literature on management of change）”，直接对应题干。
你可能会因为前面出现的“personal organization”或“documentaries”等一连串的干扰信息而分心，在此类列举题中，听到“literature on”这种核心搭配时一定要立刻抓取其后的具体学术名词。

I think you will find it very useful. They also have a collection of documentaries on the subject of personal organization, and I suggest that you look up the literature on management of change. I personally found these sources incredibly useful.
录音中教授指导在第二区可以找到“关于志愿服务性质的文章（articles on the nature of volunteering）”，直接填入该名词短语即可。
你可能虽然听到了“articles on”的提示，但没听清后面的连读，或者无法正确拼写出“volunteering”，这提醒你在平常练习中不仅要定位精准，长单词的拼写基本功也绝不能掉链子。

Articles are also a valuable resource, and we have a whole collection of them in our university library. I advise that you look at section two, where you will find articles on the nature of volunteering.
